races.paceDynamic: Westgate Warrior is the sole pace-setter among 12 runners, guaranteeing him an uncontested lead in this 5f sprint which heavily favors his front-running style. Behind him, seven horses (Papa Don't Preach, Herakles, Street Life, Jeany May, Irish Dancer, Basholo, Colors Of Freedom) all want prominent positions, creating inevitable traffic problems and interference in the final 2f as they fan out seeking racing room.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Westgate Warrior breaks cleanly and gets his preferred soft lead
scenarios.body: The lone front-runner dictates fractions without pressure while the prominent brigade battles behind him. He kicks clear in the final furlong as the pack tangles, with hold-up horses Woodhay Whisper and Popular Dream making late ground but running out of time.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners settle better than expected and avoid early scrimmaging
scenarios.body: Irish Dancer and Basholo use their tactical speed to track Westgate Warrior without getting caught in traffic. The leader tires in the final 100 yards as the best of the prominent horses surge past with cleaner runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates severe interference and a stop-start pace
scenarios.body: Woodhay Whisper and Ancient State get the perfect setup as the front-runners go too fast trying to clear the pack. Both closers sweep up the far rail as Westgate Warrior weakens and the prominent horses pay for their early exertions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses miss the break or there's significant early interference
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with pace completely fractured by trouble in running. Colors Of Freedom or Papa Don't Preach benefit from staying out of trouble as higher-rated rivals get caught up in the melee.
